description: Defines a StructuredOutputParser class for parsing LLM outputs into structured JSON, including schema conversion, JSON repair, and configuration options.

classes.name: StructuredOutputParser
classes.description: A class implementing INode to parse and structure LLM output into JSON format with schema validation and auto-fix capabilities.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the parser with default labels, description, inputs, and configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the parser with node data, creating a Zod schema, wrapping the parser, and patching the parse method to handle JSON repair.
